findings.title: Folder/project names diverge from namespaces and from the README's documented structure

evidence.excerpt:
PilotUtilityApi/
├── src/
│   ├── PilotUtilityApi.Domain/           # DTOs and domain models
...

findings.recommendation: The actual src/ and test/ folders are named PilotUtiltyApi.* (missing the second "i" in "Utility"), while the .csproj files, namespaces and the README's Project Structure diagram all use the correct "PilotUtilityApi.*" spelling. Rename the folders (and update the .sln/project references) to match the namespace spelling consistently, so folder names, project file names, namespaces and documentation all agree.

checkResults.reason: Layering itself (Domain/Repositories/Services/Web/Shared) is clean and consistent, but the on-disk folder names (PilotUtiltyApi.*) do not match the .csproj file names, C# namespaces, or the README's own Project Structure diagram (PilotUtilityApi.*), which is confusing for new contributors.
